title: Matrixed A/B Runner with Fallback Saga and Telemetry Synthesis
author: Priya Rao
body: Context and motivation: Large-scale A/B experiments and canaries at Redwood have limited combinatorial coverage when multiple model axes (model family, quantization, prompt template) are changed simultaneously. That gap exposes us to blindspots where interactions between axes cause regressions that single-dimension canaries miss. This PR implements a "matrixed A/B runner": a coordinator that schedules small, timeboxed micro-experiments that exercise combinations of variants across user slices, plus a fallback saga that can escalate to automated rollback or graceful degradation when composite signals breach configurable safety gates. The runner also includes an opt-in "telemetry synthesis" mode that injects controlled synthetic signals into metric streams for rehearsal runs (smoke, error-injection, latency-pressure) so we can verify alerting and rollback plumbing end-to-end without affecting live user metrics. -- What this changes: 1) rollout/runner: new MatrixedRunner controller that expands a candidate PromotePlan into N micro-experiments using combinatorial sampling heuristics (pairwise by default, configurable to full-factorial for small matrices). 2) workflow/saga: FallbackSaga orchestrates progressive mitigation steps (reduce traffic fraction -> promote degraded model variant -> initiate snapshot-replay -> rollback) with audit events written to rollout-ledger. 3) telemetry: TelemetrySynth module (opt-in) produces labeled synthetic traces/metrics and ties them to experiment IDs so they can be filtered/queried. 4) API: a lightweight PromotePlan v2 CRD (API surface) and CLI flags for dry-run, synth-mode, and timebox. 5) tests: end-to-end smoke harness, unit coverage for combinatorial sampler, and integration test that runs a matrixed micro-experiment in the local devstack. -- Checklist: - [x] MatrixedRunner core implementation - [x] FallbackSaga control flow + audit events - [x] TelemetrySynth with non-production partitioning - [x] PromotePlan v2 API and validation - [x] CLI flags and docs in /docs/rollouts/matrixed-runner.md - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Canary playbook excerpt for SRE runbook -- Linear/Jira ties: ENG-2143 (matrixed rollout work), ENG-2201 (fallback saga+audit), SUP-981 (customer incident that motivated matrixed experiments). -- Risk and mitigations: TelemetrySynth is opt-in and writes synthetic metrics to a dedicated test namespace and tag to avoid polluting global aggregations. The Saga's default policy is conservative: micro-experiments start at 0.1% traffic slices and scale only after passing multiple SLO checks. Rollback is a guarded operation requiring either automated consensus of metric gates OR a manual override from SRE. -- Rollout plan: 1) deploy to staging (this PR includes the k8s Job manifest for a devstack run) 2) run a dry-run matrix with synth-mode enabled 3) enable in limited production namespace behind feature flag and monitor for one week 4) flip on auto-fallback after two successful days. -- Notes: this complements existing cohort-based canaries (does not replace them); the matrixed runner is intended for multi-axis changes where existing single-dimension canaries are insufficient.

review_conversation: Marco Duarte (reviewer): Great direction — I want clarity on how experiments are mapped to user slices. Can we ensure the combinatorial sampler supports per-customer affinity constraints?
Priya Rao (author): Reply: yes — sampler supports an optional affinity policy. I added validation and a test case (tests/affinity/test_affinity_policy.py) to demonstrate the constraint behavior.

Jonas Kline (reviewer): The fallback sequence has multiple side effects (snapshot replay, model swap). We should TTL these operations and ensure idempotency. Please add expiring locks and idempotency keys.
Priya Rao: Added expiring saga locks and idempotency keys persisted in rollout-ledger. Updated docs and unit tests to assert idempotent replays.
Ariella Chen (reviewer): CI flaked on the sampler randomness test — deterministic seed required for CI. Also request small perf benchmark for sampler at 1k variant combinations.
Priya Rao: Fixed test to inject deterministic RNG in CI; added a microbenchmark and a flamegraph output for the 1k case. Benchmarks show <120ms overhead for sampler with default pairwise heuristic.
Marco Duarte: Approving after minor doc edits were addressed.
Jonas Kline: Approving — verified saga idempotency locally.
merge_outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-25 by Marco Duarte; merge commit: squash-722461-matrixed-ab-runner
release_notes: Introduces MatrixedRunner and FallbackSaga for combinatorial A/B experiments. Adds TelemetrySynth for opt-in synthetic signal generation and PromotePlan v2 API. Feature gated; enable via feature flag. See docs/rollouts/matrixed-runner.md for operator guidance.
notes_for_sre: Default conservative policies: micro-experiments start at 0.1% traffic per cell; automatic rollback requires 3 consecutive SLO violations across primary latency/error metrics. TelemetrySynth tags synthetic data with experiment_id and 'synth:true' label; ensure dashboards filter this tag when comparing production baselines.

draft runbook addendum for matrixed experiments (SRE)
schedule a 2-hour monitoring window for first prod enablement
